subject: Targeted exercise restores post-surgical knees without degrading the cartilage matrix
script: From Agewell Brief: Targeted exercise restores post-surgical knees without degrading the cartilage matrix. Supervised physical therapy applied years after ACL reconstruction relieves chronic pain and rebuilds quadriceps strength without accelerating cartilage breakdown.
